name: drone_get_capabilities
description: Read MOCK registered destinations, revision, profile and exact supported ordered sequences. Does not plan a route.

name: drone_get_status
description: Read MOCK mission occupancy and explicitly unknown physical status.

name: drone_execute_route
description: Request a MOCK mission using an externally chosen exact ordered sequence of registered IDs. Repeated non-adjacent stops are allowed. Acceptance does not establish physical execution.

name: drone_get_mission
description: Read a MOCK mission by its returned ID.

name: drone_stop_mission
description: Request MOCK mission stopping; stop_requested does not prove physical stop or landing and does not release occupancy.

name: drone_get_sensor_snapshot
description: Read a MOCK snapshot with absent readings represented as empty or null, never invented live data.

name: drone_get_captures
description: Read the empty MOCK capture collection for an existing mission.
